meta.name: Mr Good Cop or Crook
meta.description:
In this riveting docuseries, when Norway's top cop is suspected of drug trafficking, investigators must ask: Is he a good officer or a major criminal?

Ended · First aired 3 Jun 2022 · Norway · 50 min

Complete series. On your server: S1 4/4

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: Old School Cop
videos.overview: Motorcycle-riding police office Eirik Jensen uses unorthodox methods to solve cases and crosses paths with drug smuggler Gjermund Cappelen.

videos.title: Operation Silent
videos.overview: Using Cappelen as a criminal informant pays off for Jensen in some ways - but it has devastating consequences too.

videos.title: The Connection
videos.overview: Disgraced police officer Eirik Jensen stands trial for taking bribes and for aiding Gjermund Cappelen in his drug smuggling operation.

videos.title: The Fall
videos.overview: After a devastating verdict, Jensen's girlfriend, Ragna, pores over the case files, hoping to uncover key evidence in time for the appeal process.
